decision.title: Bindings paused; priorities are conformance, CLI builds, the book (owner)
decision.summary: The Swift and Kotlin bindings are paused with their designs in bindings/kotlin/DESIGN.md and bindings/swift/DESIGN.md, and work goes to conformance, CLI builds for every platform, then the book in docs/book/.

body.p: on the owner's word: "Pause the swift and kotlin work by documenting the next steps/full intended design in the respective subdirectories. Priorities now are: 1. conformance, 2. a mise task to get the CLI compiled for all supported platforms for installation, 3. user-facing documentation in book form (think: Rust book in style)."

item.p: Phase 6 is paused. bindings/kotlin/DESIGN.md and bindings/swift/DESIGN.md hold the full intended design and the exact next steps, so a later session can resume from them.

Work goes, in this order, to conformance sweeps; a mise task that builds the sxml CLI for every supported platform as installable archives; and a user-facing book in the style of "The Rust Programming Language", in docs/book/.
